lowercase_strokes: close the bowl at the top, then drop straight down
common_error: the last stroke curls back up instead of closing and dropping
fix: close the bowl, then one straight drop

uppercase_strokes: 1: vertical down, 2: back up into the bowl
lowercase_strokes: vertical down, back up into the bowl
common_error: the bowl is drawn first, so the stem leans
fix: straight down first, then come back up and out

uppercase_strokes: 1: open curve from the top right
lowercase_strokes: open curve from the top right
common_error: starts at the bottom and stops halfway, leaving a hook
fix: start at the top right, one unbroken sweep

common_error: the stem is drawn first, the way b is
fix: bowl first, then the straight drop

lowercase_strokes: loop, then the crossbar on the midline
common_error: the crossbar floats and the tail closes into an o
fix: bar on the midline, tail stops short of closing

common_error: the tail is sent below the line like a g
fix: the hat goes up, the tail stays on the baseline

lowercase_strokes: circle, then the hook below the line
common_error: below the line the child draws a second full circle
fix: a shadow hook, one dip, then back up

common_error: the shoulder starts halfway up the stem
fix: full stem to the baseline, shoulder in the middle

lowercase_strokes: short vertical, lift, then one dot
common_error: the dot is added without lifting the pencil
fix: finish the stem, lift, then one dot

uppercase_strokes: 1: vertical below the line, 2: hook, 3: dot
lowercase_strokes: vertical below the line, hook, lift, dot
common_error: written as an i that got long, hook drawn last
fix: the only letter that dives below the line then comes back for the dot

common_error: the two diagonals meet at the baseline
fix: three lines, one meeting point at the middle

common_error: a hook gets added at the bottom
fix: one straight line, top to baseline

common_error: the two humps end up different heights
fix: two humps the same, last stroke a plain drop

common_error: the second leg stops before the baseline
fix: one hump, the leg finishes on the line

common_error: a second stroke is added on top to close the gap
fix: one stroke, closed where it started

lowercase_strokes: vertical below the line, then the bowl
common_error: the bowl is put below the line, making a g
fix: the bowl sits on top, the stem drops

lowercase_strokes: circle, then the vertical below the line
common_error: it turns into a g because the bowl closes at the bottom
fix: bowl, straight drop, then a short foot

common_error: the arm is drawn as a whole hump, so it reads as n
fix: stem, then a short arm that never reaches the baseline

common_error: built as two separate curves and the join shows
fix: one stroke that reverses direction

common_error: the crossbar is placed at the very top, like an f
fix: bar above the middle, stem through it, foot on the baseline

lowercase_strokes: down, round the bottom, back up, straight
common_error: the last stroke curves out, so it looks like a y
fix: finish straight

common_error: the bottom is rounded off into a u
fix: the point has to be a point

common_error: the middle point sags below the two outer ones
fix: middle point level with its neighbours

common_error: the two strokes are laid side by side and never cross
fix: two deliberate collisions, meeting at the midline

uppercase_strokes: 1: short diagonal, 2: long diagonal below the line
lowercase_strokes: short diagonal, long diagonal below the line
common_error: the tail stops at the baseline instead of dropping
fix: dive below the line, then slant back up

common_error: the diagonal is drawn as a curve, like a stretched s
fix: two square corners and one straight diagonal
